name: Button Group
summary: Named button grouping primitive that composes canonical Button children with logical joined borders and an optional content-resilient full-width layout.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Inline wrapper for grouped Button children.

anatomy.name: button
anatomy.description: Button dependency rendered as a direct or visual child.

variants.name: full
variants.description: Full-width group where child buttons share available width.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Default grouped button size inherited from Button.

states.name: default
states.description: Default resting state; layout remains independently selected through the Default or Full variant.

behavior.name: buttonComposition
attributes: aria-label or aria-labelledby on the group
behavior.description: The group composes Button children without changing their native button or link semantics, names, disabled states, activation, or normal tab order; arrow keys are not captured.

behavior.name: logicalJoining
behavior.description: Joined borders and outer radii follow logical inline start and end so visual grouping remains correct in LTR and RTL.

behavior.name: fullWidthContentResilience
behavior.description: Full distributes available width equally and allows localized or unbroken child labels to wrap instead of creating page-level horizontal overflow.

properties.name: groupLabel
properties.description: Accessible name that explains the relationship among the grouped buttons.

accessibility: Preserve the accessible names and semantics of each child button.
Use a group label when the set of buttons needs a shared accessible context.
Do not change tab order or add Toolbar arrow-key behavior to match visual grouping.
Preserve logical joined corners and border overlap in both LTR and RTL.
Allow labels in the full-width variant to wrap without clipping focus indicators or creating page overflow.

web.notes: Implemented by named group markup, canonical Button composition, logical border joining, and resilient full-width class composition in components/css/primitives.css.
